notes.title: Update notes - Sep 20 2021
notes.content:
- Fixed issue: Player always spawned as Fast Eddie
- Fixed issue: Certain sounds not affected by sound settings
- Fixed issue: Chinese localization missing letters
- Fixed issue: NullReferenceException errors building up in game log file

- Added: Key detector; Makes keys easier to find, displaying distance for nearby keys
- Added: Story info; Details and information on game storyline

- Changed: Main menu button layout
- Changed: Scroll box color scheme
- Changed: Fallback fonts; If certain languages are missing characters, it will be replaced with a substitute character

- Removed: Redundant control; In Air Control Toggle
